testImagePipeline:
/**
 * Test the CRUD pipeline as pure data: form object in → framework processing → adapter payload out.
 *
 * No browser APIs. No File/Blob. No uploads. Just objects.
 *
 * Steps:
 * 1. `generate-payload` — generatePayload() from entity fields + your overrides
 * 2. `upload-pipeline` — merge image/file URLs you provide (no actual upload)
 * 3. `verify-full-url` — validate all Picture URLs are real https (not blob:)
 * 4. `verify-thumb-url` — same for thumb URLs
 * 5. `cleanup-image` — (skipped — nothing to clean in data-only mode)
 *
 * The output at each step is logged. You see exactly what goes in and what comes out.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * import { testImagePipeline } from '@donotdev/testing';
 * import { apartmentEntity } from '../entities/apartment';
 *
 * await testImagePipeline({
 *   entity: apartmentEntity,
 *   input: {
 *     reference: 'TEST-001',
 *     rent: 500,
 *     pictures: [{ fullUrl: 'https://storage.../full.webp', thumbUrl: 'https://storage.../thumb.webp' }],
 *   },
 * });
 * ```
 */
export declare function testImagePipeline(options: TestImagePipelineOptions): Promise<TestImagePipelineResult>;
testImageUpload:
/**
 * Test the browser image upload pipeline: processImage → uploadImage → verify URLs → cleanup.
 *
 * Uses injection — consumer passes functions from @donotdev/crud. No static import
 * of crud from testing package.
 *
 * Steps:
 * 1. `process-image` — processImage(file) → { fullBlob, thumbBlob, width, height } (skipped if not provided)
 * 2. `upload-pipeline` — uploadImage(fullBlob, thumbBlob, filename, opts) → Picture
 * 3. `verify-full-url` — HEAD request to fullUrl (skipped if verifyUrls=false)
 * 4. `verify-thumb-url` — HEAD request to thumbUrl (skipped if verifyUrls=false)
 * 5. `cleanup-image` — deleteImage(picture) (skipped if cleanup=false or deleteImage not provided)
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * import { testImageUpload } from '@donotdev/testing';
 * import { processImage, uploadImage, deleteImage } from '@donotdev/crud/utils/imageProcessing';
 *
 * await testImageUpload({
 *   fns: { processImage, uploadImage, deleteImage },
 *   storagePath: 'apartments',
 * });
 * ```
 */
export declare function testImageUpload(options: TestImageUploadOptions): Promise<TestImageUploadResult>;
generatePayload:
/**
 * Generate a test create payload for an entity, from its descriptor
 * (`describeEntity`): fields of the create schema (write classes `user`,
 * `derived`, `program`), minus `status` (the create gets `DEFAULT_STATUS_VALUE`)
 * and file fields (uploaded separately). Each value is sampled per value kind and
 * checked against the field's value schema.
 *
 * @param entity - Entity from `defineEntity()`
 * @param overrides - Values that replace generated ones (extra keys, e.g. scope fields, are kept)
 * @returns The payload
 * @throws When a field has no value overrides can supply and no sample passes its
 * schema (e.g. a required reference): names `entity.field`
 *
 * @version 0.2.0
 * @since 0.1.0
 * @author AMBROISE PARK Consulting
 */
export declare function generatePayload(entity: AnyEntity, overrides?: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown>;
getFileFields:
/**
 * Extract the file fields the create payload writes (uploaded by the test runner).
 *
 * @param entity - Entity from `defineEntity()`
 * @returns File / image fields of write classes `user`, `derived`, `program`
 *
 * @version 0.2.0
 * @since 0.1.0
 * @author AMBROISE PARK Consulting
 */
export declare function getFileFields(entity: AnyEntity): EntityField[];
SampleKind:
/** Value kinds of the descriptor (`ValueKind` in `@donotdev/core`). */
export type SampleKind = 'text' | 'number' | 'integer' | 'boolean' | 'date' | 'time' | 'timestamp' | 'json' | 'ref';
schemaAccepts:
/**
 * True when `schema` accepts `value` (Valibot via Standard Schema).
 *
 * @param schema - Valibot schema
 * @param value - Candidate value
 * @returns Whether the value passes the schema
 * @throws When `schema` is not a schema, or validates asynchronously
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.2.5
 * @author AMBROISE PARK Consulting
 */
export declare function schemaAccepts(schema: unknown, value: unknown): boolean;
sampleValue:
/**
 * Sample value of a field, from its descriptor kind and schema.
 *
 * Static options come first (row `index` picks one), then the kind's candidates
 * and the schema's structure; the first value the schema accepts is returned.
 * `ref` fields have no sample (the caller links rows or passes an id).
 *
 * @param input - Field descriptor value and validation hints
 * @param ctx - Row index and random source
 * @returns A value accepted by `input.value.schema`
 * @throws When the kind is `ref`, or no candidate passes the schema (names `entity.field`)
 *
 * @example
 * ```typescript
 * const d = describeEntity(productEntity).fields.price;
 * sampleValue({ entity: 'Product', name: 'price', value: d.value }, { index: 0, rand: Math.random });
 * ```
 *
 * @version 0.1.0
 * @since 0.2.5
 * @author AMBROISE PARK Consulting
 */
export declare function sampleValue(input: SampleInput, ctx: SampleContext): unknown;
